title: Fabulous flavors.
text:
A fabulous evening with Lily exploring the gothic quarter and enjoying fabulous food and drinks. Great experience tasting fabulous local flavours and beverages.
Great value for money.
author: Scenic61771876527

title: Great night in Gothic Quarter
text: Had a great experience with Lili. So much food and drinks and amazing historical sites along the way!
author: 300palaks

title: Phenomenal Tour! Take it!!
text: Wow! What a fantastic tour! Saw gorgeous gothic quarter, excellent places to eat away from tourist spots and our guide Juan was awesome. I have food allergies and he had each place do something that I could enjoy! Amazing, don’t miss this tour! His knowledge of the area, food and wine was wonderful! His English perfect!! Best guide ever!!
author: SandtowneGirl

title: Lili was fantastic!
text: Lili was a fantastic guide and took us to so many lovely spots! Do this instead  of dinner one night -  three hours traipsing through the city to eat and drink is a night well spent. She keeps you informed of every place you’re at, every food you’re eating, and every drink you’re enjoying. Our little group of 10 was very pleased with the experience!
author: S1429GGnatashac

title: Unique, perfect pace & lovely places
text: We had such a wonderful tour with Lili. It didn’t feel rushed at all and yet we got through so much. Each place we went to was unique and special in its own way and we had a wonderful time.
author: Relax38632457849

title: Tapas tour
text: Great evening with great company and good food

title: Food Tour in Barcelona
text:
We had the tour with Lili. We met a above the train station and stattet our tour in the goth city. She showed us many intrepid spots and the restaurants were so nice. Without her I wouldn’t get in there.
Next time i’m in Barcelona I will book a tour with her again!
author: DayTrip06996312459

title: Perfect mixture of history and local food experience
text: I am doing food tours whenever I am travelling to experience the places, food and people. And honestly, this was one of the best I’ve ever had. Lili is such a knowledgeable and experienced guide, always taking care of her group. I can highly recommend this tour to be booked by food enthusiasts and the ones who love food stories and company.
author: G2508LUnicolee

title: Tapas tour, Barcelona
text: Lili was a great guide - fun and well informed. A lovely experience of food, wine and history of the city.
author: X3461ZDbarbaral

title: Tapas Tour - Barcelona
text: Great value for the price. Food and drink were more than enough. Lili gave us a lot of history of Barcelona and took us to some great places that were not touristy. She was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We had a great time!
